University of Milan – La Statale Welcome to the University of Milan International Admissions Portal! 🎓 This platform is designed exclusively for prospective students who hold a qualification issued by a non-Italian institution. If you hold an Italian qualification, please visit the Enrolment section of our website. Ready to take the next step in your academic journey? Join one of Italy’s leading universities and start shaping your future with us! 1. Browse our degree programmes 👉 Discover everything you can study at the University of Milan. 2. Register to this platform 👉 Create your account in just a few clicks. 3. Complete your application 👉 Fill the form, upload all required documents and submit your application. You can apply for up to three degree programmes per academic year. 4. Log in regularly to your account 👉 We may contact you to request additional documents or information. Required documents may vary depending on your country of origin; for further details, please visit our University’s website. Need help? Our support team is always there for you via InformaStudenti.
